description: This Java source file defines a UserService class that provides user registration, retrieves user details, and implements UserDetailsService for Spring Security integration.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: A service class that manages user registration and retrieval, implementing UserDetailsService for authentication purposes.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user after validating the uniqueness of username and email, and hashes the password.

methods.name: getByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves a User by username, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: loadUserByUsername
methods.description: Loads user details for authentication, wrapping User data into Spring Security's UserDetails object.
